text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's early afternoon, and I'm on the<n>way home with
Shinko Windy after<n>shopping for supplies.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, did you hear? There's a<n>Chinese restaurant
by the station<n>that's famous for its giga-sized
serving of fried rice.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Oh, yeah I saw that online. It's crazy.Anyone who could finish somethingthat big would become a legend. Like,a true legend.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: ...Neeheehee! A legend, you say?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Which means... if I finish that fried<n>rice, everyone'll
pay attention to me!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I've decided where we're going for<n>lunch! Trainer,
I'm about to become a<n>legend!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, Shinko Windy takes up the
Umamusume-only challenge and<n>orders the
giga-sized fried rice.<n>However...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
...Gyaaah! I keep eating and eating<n>but this
mountain isn't getting any<n>smaller!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Not being a particularly big eater, she<n>immediately
reaches her limit.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Urghhh... I can't give up yet!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: I have to keep eating! I will become alegend!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Butt out! I'm not done eatin'!
choice_data_list:
Attempting the challenge was impressive enough
already.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Grrr!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
If you really think so, then I guess we<n>can take it
home!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I'll just have to become a legend<n>next time! And I
can't wait to see the<n>looks on everyone's faces
when I<n>do!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Despite Shinko Windy's boasting, I<n>see a hint of
relief in her expression.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: O-of course! This'll be easy!<n>Graaahhh!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy resumes eating, and<n>the other
customers around us<n>suddenly join in on the
excitement.

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text:
Oh, hey, she's taking on the giga rice<n>challenge! I
can't believe it! She's<n>really brave for that!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Wahahaha! I'll show you all what a<n>legend looks
like!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
How's that?! I cleaned the bowl!<n>Mwahahaha! And
I d-didn't even<n>break a sweat!

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text:
Wooow! You're amazing! I just<n>witnessed the birth
of an actual<n>legend!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to all the attention, Shinko<n>Windy is able to
overcome her limits.<n>She leaves the restaurant with
a<n>pained but satisfied look on her face.
